correctness.rationale: The source graph has finitely many edges with four possible tangent directions and all nonplateau affine pieces expand Euclidean arclength by sqrt2 or 2. After partitioning the survivor domains through 4 iterates, each branch has slope>=4 and positive minimal interval length delta (finite partition). Variation inequality Var(P^4 g)<=3/4 Var(g)+(2delta)^(-1)||g||_1 gives uniformly bounded surviving densities in BV. L1 compactness and open-dense plateau preimages exclude a nonzero survivor mass: a positive BV limit has a positive open subinterval, which meets open dense capture set. An absolutely-continuous invariant measure would place zero mass on plateaus and all preimages because collapse creates forbidden atoms, contradicting full capture. The argument is sound assuming the cited primary graph structure and dense-preimage lemma; no planar-area assertion is made.
